notes: FleetComm 1.4.11 — the relay was silently dropping most of the access changes COMMAND made (murmur rate-limits control messages), which is why allied operators kept meeting RESTRICTED on nets that had been opened for them. The service now paces its writes, reads every gated net back and rewrites what the relay dropped; a change lands in the background and the app shows ACCESS PENDING — RELAY SYNCING instead of RESTRICTED until it has, then tunes the held nets by itself. ACCOUNTS is grouped — the queue, one fold per allied organization, the fleet, the revoked — with one CHANGE STANDING control per row, a recommendation button (FILE AS <org> for the Discord they joined first, APPROVE for a recruit), rows locked while a change is in flight, and a relay line above the roster. Discord will ask everyone to consent once more (join dates). SETTINGS ▸ SYSTEM LOG ▸ COPY works. Audio: when the output falls off rate, playback is rate-corrected within two seconds and the heals no longer give up; the log names the output device.
